Its Tucker congruence with the Chinese PC2 was 0.952 (conditional 95% bootstrap interval 0.947–0.958; Figures S1A–C and S2A,B; Tables S5–S8). PC1 estimates were less precise: the fixed-loading OR was 1.48 (95% CI 0.97–2.25; p = 0.068), and the independently derived OR was 1.17 (95% CI 0.75–1.82; p = 0.472). Fixed-loading estimates are shown in Figure 3B and NHANES-derived estimates in Figure S3A (Table S9). Stage-specific weighted mean NHANES-derived PC2 scores are shown as descriptive estimates in Figure S3B.

正文小节: 3.4. Sensitivity Analyses of the PC2 Association
首次引用段落: The inverse PC2 association persisted after age adjustment in the Chinese derivation cohort (OR 0.49; 95% CI 0.33–0.73; p < 0.001) and in NHANES using fixed Chinese loadings (OR 0.63; 95% CI 0.49–0.83; p = 0.001; Figure S4A; Table S10). In a separate sensitivity analysis retaining the primary covariates, restricting NHANES to stages 2–4 aligned the stage comparison with that used in the Chinese cohort. Fixed-loading PC2 remained inversely associated with stages 3–4 versus stage 2 (OR 0.75 per weighted SD; 95% CI 0.58–0.97; p = 0.030; n = 1712), although the point estimate was closer to the null than in the primary NHANES analysis (Figure 3C; Table S9).

首次引用段落: Adding harmonized past-12-month alcohol use to the primary covariates yielded a fixed-loading PC2 OR of 0.51 in the NHANES alcohol-complete sample (95% CI 0.37–0.70; p < 0.001; n = 2262) and 0.67 in its stages 2–4 subset (95% CI 0.49–0.93; p = 0.018; n = 1445; Figure 3C; Figure S4B; Tables S11, S12). Leave-one-cycle-out analyses of fixed-loading PC2 yielded ORs ranging from 0.49 to 0.60, with all four 95% CIs below 1 (Figure S5A; Table S13).

In the Chinese cohort, gradient boosting was selected after benchmarking six candidate algorithms (Figure S7A–D; Tables S20, S21). The model combining baseline covariates with PC1 and PC2 (+FDP) achieved a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.672 (95% CI 0.638–0.706) for distinguishing concurrent CKM stages 3–4 from stage 2. The corresponding AUROCs were 0.571 for baseline covariates alone, 0.608 after adding BMI and 0.638 after adding visceral fat area (+VFA). The +FDP model had higher AUROC than each comparator, with paired DeLong p values <0.001 for comparisons with the baseline and +BMI models and p = 0.021 for comparison with +VFA. It also had the lowest Brier score among the four models (0.226; Figure S8A,B; Table S22).

In NHANES, separately fitted survey-weighted logistic models distinguished stages 3–4 from stages 0–2. Apparent weighted AUROCs were 0.608 for the baseline model, 0.692 for +BMI, 0.717 for +VAT and 0.721 for +FDP (Figure S12A,B; Table S25). The +FDP AUROC was therefore only 0.004 higher than that of +VAT. Corresponding weighted Brier scores are shown in Figure S12C. The NHANES +FDP model used locally derived PC1 and PC2, and all models were evaluated in the same participants used for fitting. These estimates describe apparent discrimination within NHANES. Full model specifications are provided in Table S26, and complete test statistics for the manuscript analyses are reported in Table S27.
